algorithm.reward: Completed native terminal win +1/loss -1 only; invalid batch must abort before update.
algorithm.actor_sample_weight: N/(E*episode_free_choices) if candidate_count>1, otherwise 0; E includes zero-choice episodes
algorithm.critic_sample_weight: N/(E*episode_steps); E includes all valid episodes
algorithm.advantage: return-old_value; weighted mean/variance only over free choices, equal mass per active episode
algorithm.entropy: Same weights as actor, zero for forced transitions
algorithm.KL: Report objective-weighted and conditional free-choice KL; gate conditional KL to avoid zero-choice dilution
algorithm.minibatches: Uniform random transitions; global N/E weights retained, not renormalized within minibatch
algorithm.forced_actor_optimizer: If current minibatch has no free choices, set actor gradients to None; skip actor momentum/decay/state advance
algorithm.limitations: Weighted target choice optimization only. No ability improvement implied; native battles/economics delegated.

protocol.collection: Synchronous complete-terminal waves; fixed policy across all waves; all invalid abort before PPO
